item.title: Ashley Benefield Moved To Disciplinary Confinement
item.description: The Florida Dept. of Corrections said that Ashley Benefield was moved after a battery on a corrections officer. Benefield is serving a 20-year sentence for her husband's manslaughter. (2/19/26)

item.title: Investigator: Tip About School Shooting Threat Came From Discord User
item.description: Investigator Dan Miller details phone conversations he had with Colin Gray and addresses a tip about a potential school shooting that came from a Discord user. Colt Gray is accused of killing two students and two teachers at Apalachee High School in Georgia. (2/19/26)

item.title: Former Prince Andrew Released 11 Hours After He Was Arrested
item.description: The former Prince Andrew has been released 11 hours after he was arrested on suspicion of misconduct in public office. Mountbatten-Windsor was arrested early Thursday at his home by detectives investigating his ties to the late Jeffrey Epstein. (2/19/26)
